description: This file defines interface functions and includes header guards for 'ssp_messagebus_interface'. It contains function declarations related to message bus engagement, initialization, finalization, resource management, and waiting conditions, with licensing information and a brief description.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Initiates engagement with a message bus component, taking component ID, configuration file, and path as parameters.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the message bus interface with user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up resources associated with the message bus interface, taking user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Performs a health check or status verification of the message bus with user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources allocated for the message bus, based on priority and user data.

methods.name: waitConditionReady
methods.description: Waits until the specified condition regarding message bus or component readiness state is satisfied, based on handle, component IDs, and D-Bus path.
